Dear ImGui, vendored for the SWARM viewer. MIT License: LICENSE.txt.

Source:   https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
Release:  v1.92.9b (tag), commit f1cc2ae15e53a861a874c3034aae6798fde194ab (2026-07-31)
Files:    the core (imconfig.h, imgui.h, imgui.cpp, imgui_demo.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_internal.h,
          imgui_tables.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp, imstb_rectpack.h, imstb_textedit.h, imstb_truetype.h) and the
          GLFW + OpenGL3 backends (backends/imgui_impl_glfw.*, backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.*,
          backends/imgui_impl_opengl3_loader.h), copied unmodified from the tag.

The OpenGL3 backend loads its own GL entry points (imgui_impl_opengl3_loader.h, internal to that file);
the application initializes it with GLSL "#version 430 core". CMake target: imgui (CMakeLists.txt).
To update: replace these files from a newer release tag, update this file, rebuild, run SWARM --selftest-ui.
